arxiv-2303-02056.title: Definition of dose rate for FLASH pencil-beam scanning proton therapy: A comparative study
arxiv-2303-02056.creator: Sylvain Deffet, Valentin Hamaide, Edmond Sterpin
arxiv-2303-02056.description: Abstract Background: FLASH proton therapy has the potential to reduce side effects of conventional proton therapy by delivering a high dose of radiation in a very short period of time. However, significant progress is needed in the development of FLASH proton therapy.

arxiv-2402-15803.title: Comparing transit spectroscopy pipelines at the catalogue level: evidence for systematic differences 2023 Comparing transit spectroscopy pipelines at the catalogue level: evidence for systematic differences – References
arxiv-2402-15803.creator: Lorenzo V. Mugnai, Mark R. Swain, Raissa Estrela, Gael M. Roudier
arxiv-2402-15803.description: Abstract The challenge of inconsistent results from different data pipelines, even when starting from identical data, is a recognized concern in exoplanetary science. As we transition into the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) era and prepare for the ARIEL space mission, addressing this issue becomes paramount because of its implications on our understanding of exoplanets.

arxiv-2405-13402.title: Accelerating universe at early and late times in extended Jordan-Brans-Dicke gravity
arxiv-2405-13402.creator: Kunio Kaneta, Kin-ya Oda, Motohiko Yoshimura
arxiv-2405-13402.description: Abstract We propose a scenario that can explain the early-time inflation and the late-time dark energy within a unified framework. A scalar potential combining power-law and exponential type in a context of extended Jordan-Brans-Dicke gravity is critically important for this realization.

arxiv-2510-10606.title: ViSurf: Visual Supervised-and-Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Large Vision-and-Language Models
arxiv-2510-10606.creator: Yuqi Liu Liangyu Chen Jiazhen Liu Mingkang Zhu Zhisheng Zhong Bei Yu Jiaya Jia
arxiv-2510-10606.description: Abstract Typical post-training paradigms for Large Vision-and-Language Models (LVLMs) include Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). SFT leverages external guidance to inject new knowledge, whereas RLVR utilizes internal reinforcement to enhance reasoning capabilities and overall performance.

britannica-1911-pelagius-popes.title: Pelagius (popes) (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-pelagius-popes.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-pelagius-popes.description: Article 'Pelagius (popes)' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 21), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Pelagius I., pope from 555 to 561, was a Roman by birth, and first appears in history at Constantinople in the rank of deacon, and as apocrisiarius of Pope Silverius, whose overthrow in favour of Vigilius his intrigues promoted.

pmc-11295558.title: Advances in breast cancer treatment: a systematic review of preoperative stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) for breast cancer
pmc-11295558.creator: Mateusz Bilski, Katarzyna Konat-Bąska, Maria Alessia Zerella, Stefanie Corradini, Marcin Hetnał, Maria Cristina Leonardi, Martyna Gruba, Aleksandra Grzywacz, Patrycja Hatala, Barbara Alicja Jereczek-Fossa, Jacek Fijuth, Łukasz Kuncman
pmc-11295558.description: Breast conserving treatment typically involves surgical excision of tumor and adjuvant radiotherapy targeting the breast area or tumor bed. Accurately defining the tumor bed is challenging and lead to irradiation of greater volume of healthy tissues. Preoperative stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) which target tumor may solves that issues.

pmc-11448275.title: Exploring the protective role of green tea extract against cardiovascular alterations induced by chronic REM sleep deprivation via modulation of inflammation and oxidative stress
pmc-11448275.creator: Yonca Coluk, Emine Gulceri Gulec Peker, Sembol Yildirmak, Arif Keskin, Guven Yildirim
pmc-11448275.description: BackgroundChronic Rapid eye movement (REM) sleep deprivation has been associated with various cardiovascular alterations, including disruptions in antioxidant defense mechanisms, lipid metabolism, and inflammatory responses. This study investigates the therapeutic potential of green tea extract (GTE) in mitigating these adverse effects.

pmc-11530473.title: Exploring the complexity of genome size reduction in angiosperms
pmc-11530473.creator: Akihiro Ezoe, Motoaki Seki
pmc-11530473.description: The genome sizes of angiosperms decreased significantly more than the genome sizes of their ancestors (pteridophytes and gymnosperms). Decreases in genome size involve a highly complex process, with remnants of the genome size reduction scattered across the genome and not directly linked to specific genomic structures.

pmc-12549939.title: Machine learning models for mechanical properties prediction of basalt fiber-reinforced concrete incorporating graphical user interface
pmc-12549939.creator: Md Ehtesamul Haque, Md Arifuzzaman, Kaffayatullah Khan, A. K. M. Azad, Ayed Eid Alluqmani, Abul Kashem
pmc-12549939.description: One of the most significant advancements in basalt fiber (BF) technology is its application in Basalt fiber reinforced polymers (BFRP). The production of BFRP utilizes basalt rock, a naturally abundant resource, resulting in a composite that generates approximately 74% less carbon emissions compared to traditional steel, aligning with global sustainability goals.

pmc-12604393.title: Integrated clinical and single-cell profiling of BCMA CAR-T therapy in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma
pmc-12604393.creator: Chuling Fang, Lixin Wang, Weiqiang Zhao, Lei Wang, Wenfa Huang, Ziren Chen, Yiran Wang, Kun Tan, Xiao Guo, Yuanyuan Xu, Shuhong Wang, Lijun Wang, Jingqiao Qiao, Xiangyu Meng, Ziqian He, Chuan Yu, Junhui Mei, Hongxin Wang, Yisheng Li, Li Yu
pmc-12604393.description: BackgroundDespite therapeutic advances, multiple myeloma (MM) remains incurable, especially in relapsed/refractory (R/R) disease. B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA)-targeted CAR-T therapy, exemplified by FDA-approved agents like ide-cel and cilta-cel, offers promise, yet accessibility barriers necessitate local production.MethodsThis single-arm trial evaluated safety/efficacy of autologous BCMA CAR-T cells in six R/R MM patients.

pmc-13325642.title: Co‐Culture of Mammalian Cells and Photosynthetic Microorganisms for Oxygen Supply in Engineered Tissues
pmc-13325642.creator: Meng Wang, Ahmad Furqan Hala, Vera van der Niet, Sebastian T Bok, Aylin Kara Özenler, Marcel Janssen, Maria J Barbosa, Dirk Martens, Rene H Wijffels, Jos Malda, Mylène de Ruijter
pmc-13325642.description: Ensuring an adequate supply of oxygen remains a significant challenge in the development of large engineered tissue constructs in the field of tissue engineering. To address this, novel strategies have recently been introduced, including the incorporation of photosynthetic microorganisms into engineered tissues.

pmc-13367693.title: Yttrium-90 radioembolization for neuroendocrine liver metastases: baseline vascularity predicts cytoreduction efficacy
pmc-13367693.creator: Anne Frisch, Johannes Kahn, Federico Collettini, Peter Steinhagen, Uli Fehrenbach, Bernhard Gebauer, Holger Amthauer, Imke Schatka, Paul Herzler, Gero Wieners, Willie M. Lüdemann
pmc-13367693.description: PurposeThis retrospective study in patients with neuroendocrine liver metastases analyzes baseline vascularity on MR as a predictor of tumour debulking after conventional Yttrium-90 transarterial radioembolization (TARE).Methods30 patients who underwent TARE at our center between 2015 and 2022 were retrospectively assessed. Pre- and post-treatment target lesion volumes were measured as total tumor volume (TTV) and enhancing tumor volume (ETV).

pmc-13463252.title: Climate change and health system preparedness: A scoping review of adaptation plans in Central America and the Caribbean
pmc-13463252.creator: Lidia Bonilla-Zarrazaga, Ashley Arriaga, Sofia Castro-Vargas, José Boue, Sebastian Bauhoff, Ana Mylena Aguilar-Rivera, Pamela Gongora-Salazar, Patrick Fahr
pmc-13463252.description: SummaryEvidence on how health is incorporated into climate adaptation planning in Central America and the Caribbean remains limited. We conducted a scoping review following PRISMA-ScR guidelines to characterise how climate-health adaptation is reflected across planning documents from 20 countries in this region and the extent to which key dimensions are addressed.

pmc-13539065.title: Resin Infiltration for the Management of Hypomature Amelogenesis Imperfecta: A Case Report
pmc-13539065.creator: Elsa Garot, Julia Estivals, Ana Ribeiro, Anais Cavaré, Olivia Kérourédan, Julien Van Gils
pmc-13539065.description: ObjectiveWe are aimed at describing the clinical and psychosocial benefits of resin infiltration as a minimally invasive treatment option for hypomature amelogenesis imperfecta in a child. Hypomature amelogenesis imperfecta is a rare hereditary enamel defect that significantly compromises dental esthetics, function, and psychosocial well‐being.

pmc-13561002.title: Camrelizumab plus nimotuzumab as second-line therapy for advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: a multicenter phase II study
pmc-13561002.creator: Jin Xia, Xiangrui Meng, Guozhong Jiang, Yonggui Hong, Yinghua Ji, Cailing Wang, Xiuli Yang, Yu Meng, Weijie Zhang, Zhiquan Luo, Donghai Cui, Junsheng Wang, Zhengzheng Shan, Lulu Guan, Yao Lu, Xu Yang, Chao Ren, Xiangli Meng, Hongli Wang, Ling Shen, Yaosheng Zhang, Zongqiang Kou, Taiying Lu, Qingxia
pmc-13561002.description: BackgroundTherapeutic options for advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) after first-line failure remain limited, particularly in patients previously exposed to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). We evaluated the efficacy, safety, and exploratory biomarker correlates of camrelizumab, an ICI, combined with nimotuzumab, an anti-epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) monoclonal antibody, as second-line therapy for ESCC.
